vision.vision_statement.value: Turn content scattered across permitted sources into trustworthy, evidence-backed information that each connected system can use.

vision.value.value: Reduce repeated collection and interpretation while retaining source evidence and independent consumer decisions.

vision.principles.value:
- Register sources deliberately; browsing stays within an explicit scope and budget.
- Capture once and preserve originals; decisions and derived fields remain versioned.
- Use a small common envelope plus content-type and system-specific schemas.
- A content item can qualify for zero, one or several systems independently.
- Unknown, unavailable and rejected are different states; no silent fabrication.
- Every extracted fact and decision must be inspectable against its evidence.
- Final qualification and destination validation precede storage and delivery.
- Human corrections are audited and rechecked; source evidence is not overwritten.

vision.non_goals.value:
- Unrestricted web crawling
- Bypassing source access controls
- Guaranteed extraction from arbitrary formats
- Unreviewed high-impact decisions
- Model training on captured content by default

name: Analyst time per accepted record
definition: Median active analyst minutes from item opening to a correct qualified record; compare paired records with the manual baseline.

target: Proposed: >=95% overall; each critical field and source family reported separately.
denominator: Proposed frozen acceptance set: >=200 items and >=30 per material slice; oversample costly failure cases separately.
baseline: UNCONFIRMED

- id: M03

target: Proposed: precision >=95%, recall >=90%; report abstention and review rates.
denominator: Frozen positive and negative set per system, including sampled rejects and multi-system overlaps.
baseline: UNCONFIRMED

strategy.priority_users_use_cases.value: Proposed pilot: an analyst turns permitted funding or procurement notices into qualified opportunity records. This is an example wedge, not a user-approved market choice.

strategy.choices_tradeoffs.value:
- id: ST-01
title: Start with one operational workflow
choice: Proposed pilot: an analyst turns permitted funding or procurement notices into qualified opportunity records. This is an example wedge, not a user-approved market choice.
tradeoff: Broad platform positioning before proving repeatable value delays learning.
decision: DEC-01
- id: ST-02
title: Prove the complete loop first
choice: R1 supports a small approved HTML/PDF source set, two independent system configurations and one validated delivery contract. Use a sandbox receiver until a real destination is authorised.
tradeoff: General connectors and every media type are deferred, while the data model remains extensible.
decision: DEC-02
- id: ST-03
title: Evidence before automation volume
choice: Preserve originals, coverage, field evidence, rule reasons and review outcomes. Autonomous delivery only follows approved system policy.
tradeoff: A lower throughput with inspectable decisions is preferable to unmeasured automated output.
decision: DEC-03
- id: ST-04
title: Separate relevance from qualification
choice: First decide relevance per system; then extract that system’s fields and apply business rules. Enrich when allowed and requalify.
tradeoff: Avoid one global classifier determining eligibility for every consumer.
decision: DEC-04
- id: ST-05
title: Reuse infrastructure, own the workflow
choice: Evaluate existing capture, parsing, OCR and transcription components. Build the policy, evidence, schema, review and routing layer around measured requirements.
tradeoff: No vendor, model, runtime or subscription is selected by this plan.
decision: DEC-05
- id: ST-06
title: Expand on observed evidence
choice: Advance from controlled pilot to authenticated/multimodal breadth and then scale only after release exit and learning reviews.
tradeoff: Dates and staffing commitments wait for estimation and explicit capacity.
decision: DEC-06

title: Extend media and recurring workflows
outcome: Operators process supported images, scanned documents and audiovisual content with region/time evidence, and manage recurring source updates.

entry: R1 outcome review supports expansion; media rights, provider limits, language slices and modality evaluation contracts are approved.
exit: Each added modality/access adapter meets its own coverage, critical-field, safety and recovery gates; partial and unavailable media are explicit.
learn: Compare incremental value, human correction and cost by modality; disable or narrow modalities that fail their approved gates.

horizon: Later / measured scale
title: Operate repeatably across more systems
outcome: Expand qualified connectors and throughput within measured tenant isolation, latency, reliability and cost limits.

exit: Named workload/load/recovery tests meet approved targets; on-call response and tenant isolation are exercised.

strategy.reuse_decisions.value: Evaluate existing capture, parsing, OCR and transcription components. Build the policy, evidence, schema, review and routing layer around measured requirements.

strategy.dependencies_assumptions.value:
- A real workflow has enough value and permitted examples to support a pilot.
- Source and system scopes can be enforced consistently.
- Users can bound collection without accidentally broadening scope.
- At least one authorised login flow is supportable without exposing secrets.
- Supported pages can be captured durably within limits.
- Extracted fields retain enough evidence to be useful.
- Operators can distinguish versions and duplicates.
- A small core envelope plus extensions captures needed information.
- One captured item can be judged independently for multiple systems.
- Qualification can be explained using typed values and deterministic rules.
- Review effort is lower than manual entry while preserving correctness.
- Additional lookups improve completeness within bounded cost.
- The destination supports reliable identity and recovery.
- A frozen acceptance set predicts real pilot quality.
- The team can detect, recover and govern failures.
- Operators understand the setup and review flow without training-heavy workarounds.

release_goal.measures_targets.value:
- id: M01
name: Analyst time per accepted record
definition: Median active analyst minutes from item opening to a correct qualified record; compare paired records with the manual baseline.
target: Proposed: at least 50% reduction on 30 or more paired items.
denominator: All paired items attempted; failures retained separately rather than dropped.
baseline: UNCONFIRMED
observed: UNCONFIRMED
window: First 4 pilot weeks; extend if fewer than 30 pairs.
uncertainty: Report paired distribution and bootstrap interval; avoid causal claims from an uncontrolled pilot.
- id: M02
name: Critical-field correctness
definition: Correct critical-field values / adjudicated critical-field opportunities; required missing values count as incorrect.
target: Proposed: >=95% overall; each critical field and source family reported separately.
denominator: Proposed frozen acceptance set: >=200 items and >=30 per material slice; oversample costly failure cases separately.
baseline: UNCONFIRMED
observed: UNCONFIRMED
window: Before each candidate promotion.
uncertainty: Report numerator, denominator and 95% Wilson intervals; sample adequacy and release thresholds require approval.
- id: M03
name: System relevance precision and recall
definition: Precision = true relevant routes / all routes; recall = true relevant routes / all adjudicated relevant items, computed independently per system.
target: Proposed: precision >=95%, recall >=90%; report abstention and review rates.
denominator: Frozen positive and negative set per system, including sampled rejects and multi-system overlaps.
baseline: UNCONFIRMED
observed: UNCONFIRMED
window: Before publication and weekly during pilot.
uncertainty: Report per-system/slice counts and intervals. Empty or inadequate slices cannot pass.
- id: M06
name: Cost and review burden
definition: Total capture, storage, model and human-review cost / accepted records; review queue arrival and completion rates.
target: Pending approved cost ceiling and reviewer capacity. Report capture-to-record p50/p95 latency.
denominator: Include rejected items, retries and failed runs in total cost.
baseline: UNCONFIRMED
observed: UNCONFIRMED
window: Weekly pilot monitoring.
uncertainty: No cost, latency or scalability claim until workload and budget are approved.

release_goal.measures_targets.value:
- id: M01
name: Analyst time per accepted record
definition: Median active analyst minutes from item opening to a correct qualified record; compare paired records with the manual baseline.
target: Proposed: at least 50% reduction on 30 or more paired items.
denominator: All paired items attempted; failures retained separately rather than dropped.
baseline: UNCONFIRMED
observed: UNCONFIRMED
window: First 4 pilot weeks; extend if fewer than 30 pairs.
uncertainty: Report paired distribution and bootstrap interval; avoid causal claims from an uncontrolled pilot.
- id: M02
name: Critical-field correctness
definition: Correct critical-field values / adjudicated critical-field opportunities; required missing values count as incorrect.
target: Proposed: >=95% overall; each critical field and source family reported separately.
denominator: Proposed frozen acceptance set: >=200 items and >=30 per material slice; oversample costly failure cases separately.
baseline: UNCONFIRMED
observed: UNCONFIRMED
window: Before each candidate promotion.
uncertainty: Report numerator, denominator and 95% Wilson intervals; sample adequacy and release thresholds require approval.
- id: M03
name: System relevance precision and recall
definition: Precision = true relevant routes / all routes; recall = true relevant routes / all adjudicated relevant items, computed independently per system.
target: Proposed: precision >=95%, recall >=90%; report abstention and review rates.
denominator: Frozen positive and negative set per system, including sampled rejects and multi-system overlaps.
baseline: UNCONFIRMED
observed: UNCONFIRMED
window: Before publication and weekly during pilot.
uncertainty: Report per-system/slice counts and intervals. Empty or inadequate slices cannot pass.
- id: M04
name: Evidence coverage
definition: Delivered non-null extracted field values with valid evidence pointers / all delivered non-null extracted field values. Derived values must identify inputs and transformation.
target: Proposed hard invariant: 100%; no fabricated citation accepted.
denominator: Every delivered record in the qualified candidate test and pilot audit.
baseline: UNCONFIRMED
observed: UNCONFIRMED
window: Each delivery and pilot audit.
uncertainty: A pointer’s existence is not proof of semantic support; M02 and human audit assess support.
- id: M05
name: Recovery and destination safety
definition: Replay, crash, timeout, cancellation, stale update and permission-revocation scenarios preserve controlled effects.
target: Proposed: zero unauthorised disclosures and zero duplicate destination effects in the required scenario suite.
denominator: All named scenarios for each supported connector and destination.
baseline: UNCONFIRMED
observed: UNCONFIRMED
window: Before pilot and affected connector changes.
uncertainty: Zero observed failures is a test result, not proof that failures are impossible.
- id: M06
name: Cost and review burden
definition: Total capture, storage, model and human-review cost / accepted records; review queue arrival and completion rates.
target: Pending approved cost ceiling and reviewer capacity. Report capture-to-record p50/p95 latency.
denominator: Include rejected items, retries and failed runs in total cost.
baseline: UNCONFIRMED
observed: UNCONFIRMED
window: Weekly pilot monitoring.
uncertainty: No cost, latency or scalability claim until workload and budget are approved.

user_story.information_continuity_coordi.value: Retain item/source/version/system identity through stages; preserve originals; isolate per-system decisions; carry explicit partial/unknown status and prevent stale overwrites.

user_story.context_trigger.value: As a connection owner, I want to reauthenticate a failed connection, so that blocked jobs resume safely.

user_story.in_scope.value: As a connection owner, I want to reauthenticate a failed connection, so that blocked jobs resume safely.

user_story.out_of_scope.value: Capabilities not expressed by these criteria; unsupported sources/media; unapproved external effects.

user_story.main_journey.value: Given an expired session, when collection fails, then the job becomes Needs access and is not endlessly retried.

user_story.adverse_behaviour.value:
- When the owner reconnects and verification succeeds, then authorised jobs resume from the failed stage.
- If the source account changes, then collection pauses for identity confirmation and permissions are re-evaluated.

user_story.interaction_accessibility.value: Keyboard access, clear focus and errors; review at 360 CSS pixels; status not conveyed only by colour.

user_story.context_trigger.value: As a analyst, I want to link equivalent content across sources, so that duplicates do not create repeated work.

user_story.in_scope.value: As a analyst, I want to link equivalent content across sources, so that duplicates do not create repeated work.

user_story.out_of_scope.value: Capabilities not expressed by these criteria; unsupported sources/media; unapproved external effects.

user_story.main_journey.value: Given exact duplicates within an authorised scope, then the system preserves separate source provenance while linking a common identity.

user_story.adverse_behaviour.value:
- Given approximate matches, then a reviewer can link or keep separate with a reason.
- When two sources have different permissions, then deduplication never exposes one source through the other.

user_story.interaction_accessibility.value: Keyboard access, clear focus and errors; review at 360 CSS pixels; status not conveyed only by colour.

owner: UNCONFIRMED

user_story.operation_contracts.value: The story actor acts within the permitted workspace/source/system scope. Persist changes with a version token; audit actor, time and evidence; model outputs never authorise tool access. Exact API and connector contracts await engineering design.

user_story.permissions_refusal.value: Only permitted workspace/source/system scope; no source access bypass.

user_story.information_continuity_coordi.value: Retain item/source/version/system identity through stages; preserve originals; isolate per-system decisions; carry explicit partial/unknown status and prevent stale overwrites.

- When a deadline equals the configured boundary, then the documented inclusive/exclusive operator is applied and tested.

user_story.information_continuity_coordi.value: Retain item/source/version/system identity through stages; preserve originals; isolate per-system decisions; carry explicit partial/unknown status and prevent stale overwrites.

user_story.out_of_scope.value: Capabilities not expressed by these criteria; unsupported sources/media; unapproved external effects.

user_story.main_journey.value: Given a previously qualified item whose deadline has passed, then delivery-time validation blocks or reroutes it according to policy.

user_story.adverse_behaviour.value:
- When rules or source facts change, then earlier decisions stay immutable and a new decision supersedes them.
- When rechecking cannot complete, then delivery is held with a reason.

user_story.permissions_refusal.value: Only permitted workspace/source/system scope; no source access bypass.

user_story.information_continuity_coordi.value: Retain item/source/version/system identity through stages; preserve originals; isolate per-system decisions; carry explicit partial/unknown status and prevent stale overwrites.

- When a status changes, then text accompanies colour and assistive technology receives a meaningful update.

user_story.information_continuity_coordi.value: Retain item/source/version/system identity through stages; preserve originals; isolate per-system decisions; carry explicit partial/unknown status and prevent stale overwrites.

user_story.in_scope.value: As a workspace member, I want to recover from network or session interruptions, so that configuration and review work are not silently lost.

user_story.out_of_scope.value: Capabilities not expressed by these criteria; unsupported sources/media; unapproved external effects.

user_story.main_journey.value: When a draft has unsaved changes, then navigation warns or offers a recoverable draft.

user_story.adverse_behaviour.value:
- Given a failed save, then the UI retains input and shows retry without claiming success.
- When permissions change while a draft is open, then submission is blocked and no inaccessible source content is retained in a new draft.

user_story.interaction_accessibility.value: Keyboard access, clear focus and errors; review at 360 CSS pixels; status not conveyed only by colour.

user_story.permissions_refusal.value: Only permitted workspace/source/system scope; no source access bypass.

user_story.information_continuity_coordi.value: Retain item/source/version/system identity through stages; preserve originals; isolate per-system decisions; carry explicit partial/unknown status and prevent stale overwrites.

id: US-1408
epic: E14
release: R3

user_story.specification_state.value: proposed; legacy wording preserved where applicable

user_story.context_trigger.value: As a operator, I want to track connector health and compatibility, so that broken sites can be isolated.

user_story.in_scope.value: As a operator, I want to track connector health and compatibility, so that broken sites can be isolated.

user_story.out_of_scope.value: Capabilities not expressed by these criteria; unsupported sources/media; unapproved external effects.

user_story.main_journey.value: When a connector release is tested, then representative capture checks must pass before activation.

user_story.adverse_behaviour.value:
- When a layout change causes repeated empty captures, then the connector is flagged and affected sources can be paused.
